items.q: I used to stop and work with Peanuts in Denver, he had a club there

ctx.x: Yeah, you're putting the cart before the horse, there, because I'd been with George and I used to stop and work with Peanuts in Denver, he had a club there, with Davi McKenna and Morry Feld.
